I also did not find a clean, direct source showing Srettha personally authorizing surveillance operations; the strongest evidence is instead institutional continuity and harassment of critics under the state apparatus during his tenure.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024 report page","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/thailand/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House says there were no reports of the state blocking or throttling fixed-line or mobile connections during the coverage period.
